notes.title: May 6th Minor Update
notes.notes:
Today's update made some minor balance changes to address player feedback around boss enemies and also corrected some outdated tool tip entries:
[list]
[*] The Spider’s health and speed were decreased.
[*] The Giant Isopod’s speed was slightly decreased
[*] Steggy’s attack damage was increased as it upgrades.
[*] Viktor’s descriptions were updated, the word “Raptor” is replaced with “Viktor”
[*] Cera’s crown ability description was updated. The ability was changed in a previous update, but the description had not been updated to match the new effect. 
[/list]

There are also a number of bugfixes. Most notably, the meteor event would sometimes incorrectly trigger on wave 5 but should now always trigger on the correct wave for that level (usually wave 10).

notes.title: Dinos TD 1.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Today we are pushing build 1.1 for Dinos TD! We have a few exciting new additions!

[b][u]Tutorial[/u][/b]
A new tutorial has been added for new and returning players! Tutorials can be permanently disabled in the options menu. 

[b][u]New Dinos[/u][/b]
Steggy the Stegosaurus specializes in slowing enemies down with his spikes! They also do damage over time which is good for groups of enemies.

Rippah the Spinosaurus can attack in front and behind them. Strategic positioning is key to utilizing them.

[u][b]Title Screen[/b][/u]
We have added a new dynamic title screen replacing the static one from the launch build.

[u][b]Crown Abilities[/b][/u]
All dinos now have new crown abilities. Upgrading them to level three will give them new tricks to help fight the insect army. 

[u][b]New Enemies[/b][/u]
New insect enemies have been added to the game including a fly, isopod, and spider.

[u][b]Credits[/b][/u]
The credits button now has actual credits! Check it out to see all of the people who put in so much hard work into the game!

[u][b]Challenge Modes[/b][/u]
We’ve added 3 new challenge modes to spice up gameplay. You can find them on the level select screen.

[u][b]Balancing and Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
Many balancing issues and bug fixes have been addressed in this update.
